data.body: PLAN_AMENDMENT: T4 must include all required H2 sections in the curator agent body (not just CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT). Required sections per DD5 + T1 test: ## CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT (when emitted: < 20 incidents; format: CORPUS_INSUFFICIENT: EXPLANATION:<reason>), plus substantive content (>= 3 non-empty lines) under: keyword scan procedure, anti-hallucination validation step, output format (JSONL per inference-incident-schema.md). T1's test_curator_agent_references_corpus_insufficient_signal checks for the section heading -- T4 must also ensure the body under that heading is non-trivial.
